about.pageDescription: A full-stack software engineer from the Upper Solimões, building products with craft and precision.
about.name: Marcos Jhollyfer Rodrigues
about.bio1: I was born in the Amazon and I'm the first Indigenous Tikuna software engineer to leave my region. That place shows up in every technical decision I make — from an architecture to a single word in an interface.
about.bio2: Over the last five years I've moved from intern to tech lead across corporate systems, B2B products and cultural preservation work. I like small teams, short cycles and conscious decisions about trade-offs.
about.bio3: Good engineering is quiet: code that ages well, interfaces that don't call attention to themselves, products people can use without learning. That's what I try to ship every sprint.
